summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted due to inability to tolerate oral intake and significant weight loss from chronic gastrojejunal ulcers following Roux-en-Y gastric bypass. She underwent placement of a tunneled central line for initiation of total parenteral nutrition. IV pantoprazole was continued to promote ulcer healing, and her nutrition regimen was gradually advanced. Pre-albumin improved slightly, indicating early nutritional recovery. A Chronic Pain consult led to optimization of her pain regimen with increased oxycodone frequency and discontinuation of Roxicet. She tolerated a stage 5 diet by discharge, was stable vitally, and was discharged home on nocturnal TPN with home nursing support and follow-up plans.
problems: Gastrojejunal ulcer, unspecified as acute or chronic, without mention of hemorrhage or perforation, without mention of obstruction
